title: Configurer DNS Quad9
description: Configure les serveurs DNS Quad9 (9.9.9.9 et 149.112.112.112) avec blocage automatique des domaines malveillants.

windowsCommandTemplate.name: Set-DnsClientServerAddress
windowsCommandTemplate.commandPattern: $interface = Get-NetAdapter | Where-Object {$_.Status -eq 'Up' -and $_.Name -like '*{InterfaceName}*'} | Select-Object -First 1; if ($interface) { Set-DnsClientServerAddress -InterfaceIndex $interface.ifIndex -ServerAddresses ('9.9.9.9','149.112.112.112'); Write-Host "Quad9 DNS configured on interface $($interface.Name)" -ForegroundColor Green; ipconfig /flushdns } else { Write-Host "Network interface not found" -ForegroundColor Red }

parameters.name: InterfaceName
parameters.label: Nom de l'interface réseau
parameters.description: Nom de l'interface réseau (Ethernet, Wi-Fi, etc.)
